skill.name: ndl-books
skill.description: 国立国会図書館サーチ(NDL Search)の公式API(OpenSearch / SRU)で書誌を検索する。ISBN・タイトル・著者名・任意キーワードでの検索に対応し、タイトル(読み)・著者・出版社・刊行年・資料種別(紙/電子)・書誌IDを返す。APIキー・ログイン不要。図書館の蔵書・貸出状況はcalil-books、全文が読める青空文庫はaozora(採用予定)を使う。購入・書評・在庫(書店)は対象外。
skill.summary: Search Japanese bibliographic records through NDL Search by ISBN, title, author, or keywords without an API key.
skill.author: tahodev

content.user_title: Search Japanese Books with NDL Search
content.value_statement: Finding reliable publication details can require checking several editions and formats. This skill retrieves NDL bibliographic records by ISBN, title, author, or keywords.
actual_capabilities: Search the official NDL OpenSearch API by ISBN, partial title, author, or multiple keywords.
Remove ISBN hyphens and URL-encode query parameters automatically.
Return available titles, kana readings, authors, publishers, publication dates, ISBNs, bibliographic IDs, material categories, and record links.
Apply a media-type filter, requested result count, and starting index through helper arguments.
Report the total match count and returned record count in structured output.
Provide a direct SRU query example for searches outside the OpenSearch helper.
limitations: Does not provide library holdings, loan availability, bookstore inventory, purchases, reviews, or full text.
Requires Python 3 and network access; service maintenance or connection failures can interrupt searches.
Partial title searches can include unrelated records, and one ISBN can match multiple editions or formats.
The helper parses OpenSearch only and keeps the first value for several fields; missing metadata can remain empty.

use_cases.title: Verify Publication Details
use_cases.description: Retrieve available author, publisher, publication date, and ISBN information before preparing a bibliography.

use_cases.title: Compare Catalog Records
use_cases.description: Review records sharing an ISBN and compare publication dates and paper or electronic material categories.

use_cases.title: Find Japanese Publications
use_cases.description: Search by author or topic keywords and inspect titles, kana readings, and links to NDL records.

prompt_templates.title: Look Up an ISBN
prompt_templates.prompt: Search NDL for ISBN [ISBN]. Summarize available titles, authors, publishers, publication dates, material types, and record links.

prompt_templates.title: Refine a Title Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search NDL for title [title], filter to books, and return five records. Report total matches and identify partial-title matches.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: narrow a broad title search.

prompt_templates.title: Compare an Author's Records
prompt_templates.prompt: Search NDL for author [author] in pages of ten. Compare available dates and formats, keeping distinct records separate and marking missing fields.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: review multiple records with pagination.

prompt_templates.title: Use a Complex SRU Query
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an NDL SRU CQL query for [topic], [material type], and [year range]. Verify supported fields and summarize results separately from OpenSearch output.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: use the documented SRU endpoint rather than the helper.

output_examples.input: Search for Yukiguni and summarize the bundled three-record fixture.
output: Fixture snapshot: 7,719 total matches; three records returned.
The records are magazine articles with paper material categories, not necessarily the novel.
Publication dates in these records are 2004-01-01, 2005-07-01, and 2006-01-01.
NDL record links are available; publisher and ISBN fields are empty in these fixture items.

output_examples.input: Explain how the helper handles ISBN 978-4-10-101001-4.
output_examples.output: The helper removes hyphens and searches for ISBN 9784101010014. It requests ten records by default and preserves separate returned records.

best_practices: Use ISBN when available, then compare material categories and publication dates before selecting a record.
Keep result pages small and use the helper for automatic query encoding.
Treat returned metadata as source data, verify record links, and use publication dates rather than RSS update timestamps.
anti_patterns: Assuming every partial-title match is the intended book or every ISBN has exactly one record.
Using bibliographic search results as proof of lending availability, purchase stock, or access to full text.
Sending confidential notes as search terms or manually inserting unencoded text into API URLs.

faq.question: Do I need an API key or account?
faq.answer: No API key, login, or user registration is required for the documented NDL searches.

faq.question: What search fields are supported?
faq.answer: The helper supports ISBN, partial title, author, and keyword searches. It also accepts media type, result count, and starting index.

faq.question: What does the helper require?
faq.answer: It requires Python 3 and network access. It uses the Python standard library without external packages.

faq.question: How many records are returned by default?
faq.answer: The helper requests ten records by default. The documentation states that direct OpenSearch calls without cnt default to 200.

faq.question: Can it check library loans or provide full text?
faq.answer: No. It retrieves bibliographic metadata and record links, not loan status, bookstore inventory, or full text.

faq.question: Does the Python helper support SRU?
faq.answer: No. The helper builds OpenSearch requests and parses RSS XML. The documentation provides a separate direct SRU example.
